en: Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view of a European city center with 19th‑century stone and brick buildings bordering a tree‑filled square or park. In the foreground are large, ornate multi‑story buildings with arched windows and classical facades; in the background are hills dotted with houses and some industrial chimneys. The lower left corner contains a printed caption in a Scandinavian language.
